title: Latent Canvas
tagline: Real-time generative vector studio and parametric design workbench
description: An interactive digital canvas combining vector geometry manipulation with local machine learning models for fast prototyping, SVG synthesis, and parametric pattern generation.
highlights: Export directly to clean SVG and Canvas bytecode

title: PulseWire
tagline: Distributed event tracer and telemetry visualizer for micro-architectures
description: High-throughput stream visualizer designed to diagnose distributed event flows, trace spans, and highlight cascading bottlenecks without heavy APM overhead.

title: WaveForge
tagline: Modular WebAudio node synthesizer and algorithmic sound laboratory
description: In-browser sound exploration station featuring patchable oscillators, bi-quad filters, frequency modulation, and wavetable sequencing with low-latency DSP.
highlights: Lossless WAV stem and patch preset export

title: ZeroVault
tagline: Client-side cryptographic safe and ephemeral secret sharing tool
description: Zero-trust encrypted payload dispenser leveraging modern WebCrypto PBKDF2 and AES-GCM 256-bit keys. Keys never leave browser memory.

title: GeoCraft
tagline: Lightweight geospatial cartography and tile rasterizer
description: A high-precision GeoJSON vector parser and topological heatmapper optimized for rendering large urban datasets smoothly without third-party mapping SDK locks.
highlights: Quadtree spatial indexing for instant point-in-polygon queries
Color ramp customization and elevation gradient mapping

title: HyperType
tagline: Distraction-free typographic laboratory and font pairing workbench
description: Editorial typographic preview suite with dynamic optical sizing, variable font weight interpolation, reading rhythm metrics, and contrast verification.
highlights: Live variable axes control (wght, wdth, opsz, slnt)
Export CSS type scale rules and token definitions

title: ChronoBench
tagline: High-resolution micro-benchmark runner for JavaScript engines
description: Microsecond benchmark harness with statistical jitter analysis, memory heap sampling, garbage collection impact detection, and exportable flamecharts.
highlights: Warmup cycle normalization and outlier elimination
Runs isolated in dedicated Web Workers

title: NeuralBrief
tagline: Hierarchical document synthesizer and knowledge card generator
description: Converts dense research papers and technical specifications into structured executive summaries, concept graphs, and actionable bullet takeaways.
